text:
nina: quick sync note — 16-shard safetensors bundle caused heavy IO tail due to many tiny layer reads.

raj: yeah, our prefetch groups by layer which is bad when layers are sub-4KB. backend sees tons of small range ops.

olivia: flame shows parse->read_blob(4-10ms many small)->memcpy. streaming path serializes parse+copy.

marcus: options: 1) pack small layers into an inline region at bundle time, 2) runtime coalesce ranges using hints or heuristics.

nina: proposal: optional artifact metadata "warmup_hints" with coalesce_window_bytes + ordered hot layers. loader falls back if absent.

raj: implement loader flow: index-first if present; else consult hints; coalesce adjacent ranges <= window; issue async reads + prealloc to avoid copies.

olivia: metrics to add: small_read_count, coalesce_efficiency, per-tensor ready_latency. guard to revert if coalescing hurts critical latency.

marcus: short-term use hints; long-term add packager that emits packed bundles optimized for mmap.

nina: infra-bot please run perf: A current, B coalesce heuristics, C coalesce+artifact hints.

infra-bot: perf job ML-2475 scheduled on dedicated-small, 3 configs x 10 runs, ETA 48h.

olivia: pushed draft PR #1472 with schema sketch.

nina: next: raj/olivia spike coalescing (2d), marcus define minimal hints schema (1d). end.
